name: Gakuensei Hakusho 2
source:
A guy found out that he has a brain tumor and has about one year to live. His best friend made a bet with him to see who can catch some girls first. Will he live out his last year happy? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩发现自己患了脑瘤，大约还能活一年。他最好的朋友和他打赌，看谁先追到女孩。他能快乐地度过最后一年吗？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
